description: Creates or updates time-off types, policies, allotments and blackout periods, each matched by itemId then name. A record that is updated takes every member of the entry, so a member left out goes back to its default. Types are imported first, so the other records can name a type of the same step; teams named must exist.

items.description: A time-off type, such as vacation or sick leave.

itemId.description: The type's id. When it matches a stored type, that type is updated; otherwise the type is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

unit.description: Whether balances are kept in hours or days. Defaults to Hours.

hoursPerDay.description: The hours a day of time off counts as. Defaults to 8.

isPaid.description: Whether the time off is paid. Defaults to true.

requiresBalance.description: Whether a request needs enough balance. Defaults to true.

allowPartialDay.description: Whether part of a day can be asked for. Defaults to true.

requiresReason.description: Whether a request needs a reason.

countsAgainstAllotment.description: Whether the time off takes a place in the team's allotment. Defaults to true.

payCode.description: The pay code the time off is paid under.

visibleToWorkers.description: Whether workers can ask for it themselves. Defaults to true.

enabled.description: Whether the type can be used. Defaults to true.

stageId.description: The id of the Time Tracker stage approved time off of this type is kept in, when Time Tracker is on.

Types.description: The time-off types to create or update.

items.description: An accrual policy: how a balance of a type grows.

itemId.description: The policy's id. When it matches a stored policy, that policy is updated; otherwise the policy is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

typeName.description: The time-off type, by name. Wins over typeId.

accrualMethod.description: How the balance grows. Defaults to PerPeriod.

frequency.description: How often a per-period accrual is added. Defaults to Monthly.

anchorDate.description: A date the accrual periods count from.

rate.description: The amount added each period, each hour worked, or each year, in the type's unit.

items.description: A rate that applies from a length of service.

fromMonths.description: The months of service the rate starts at.

tenureTiers.description: Higher rates after a length of service.

waitingPeriodDays.description: The days after hire before the balance grows.

maxBalance.description: The largest balance; null for no cap.

carryoverMax.description: The most that carries over at the reset; null for all of it.

resetMonth.description: The month the balance resets, 1 to 12. Defaults to 1.

resetDay.description: The day of the month the balance resets. Defaults to 1.

negativeBalanceLimit.description: How far below zero the balance may go.

teamNames.description: The teams the policy applies to, by name; each is added to assignments.

workerId.description: A worker's id, for a policy of one worker.

assignments.description: The teams or workers the policy applies to.

enabled.description: Whether the policy is in use. Defaults to true.

Policies.description: The accrual policies to create or update.

items.description: An allotment: how many people of a team may be off each day.

itemId.description: The allotment's id. When it matches a stored allotment, that allotment is updated; otherwise the allotment is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamName.description: The team, by name. Wins over teamId.

typeNames.description: The time-off types it counts, by name; added to typeIds.

typeIds.description: The time-off types it counts, by id; empty for every type that counts against allotments.

weekdaySlots.description: How many people may be off on each weekday: seven numbers, Monday first.

items.description: The places on one date, instead of the weekday's.

slots.description: How many people may be off that day.

dates.description: Dates with their own number of places.

autoApprove.description: Whether a request is approved while there are places. Defaults to true.

whenFull.description: What happens to a request when the day is full. Defaults to Waitlist.

enabled.description: Whether the allotment is in use. Defaults to true.

Allotments.description: The allotments (how many people may be off a day) to create or update.

items.description: A blackout period: dates when time off can't be asked for.

itemId.description: The blackout period's id. When it matches a stored blackout period, that blackout period is updated; otherwise the blackout period is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamName.description: The team, by name. Wins over teamId.

teamId.description: The team, by id; null for every team.

typeNames.description: The time-off types it blocks, by name; added to typeIds.

typeIds.description: The time-off types it blocks, by id; empty for every type.

message.description: What a worker who asks is told.

enabled.description: Whether the blackout is in use. Defaults to true.

BlackoutPeriods.description: The blackout periods (when time off can't be asked for) to create or update.
